Hi all — quick note on the quantization tradeoffs based on our preliminary runs with FinWave sample set attached:

- AWQ (Mistral-7B AWQ3): ~2.6x throughput improvement vs FP16 on our Dedicated nodes; top-line entity F1 drop = 1.8% (within your tolerance) but saw edge-case date formatting errors in ~0.6% of samples
- GPTQ-4bit (Llama2-13B GPTQ): ~4.1x throughput improvement; F1 drop = 3.9% — we saw notable degradation on long-context date resolution
- FP8 (experimental): ~3.2x throughput; F1 drop = 2.2% but currently only available on select Dedicated configs; requires tuning and may increase memory pressure

Recommendations:
1) Start with Mistral-7B AWQ profile for a production pilot — best cost/quality balance.
2) Keep Llama2-13B FP16 as fallback for critical paths (e.g., high-confidence legal extractions).
3) We'll add targeted prompt engineering and eval-focused instruction tuning to recover the 0.6% date errors.

I'll attach the CSV with per-prompt diffs and the benchmark link.
